I want to know about fuel and cost anomalies without creating reports manually
I want fields across multiple vehicle entries to be updated from a single document
Some actions will require context I don't trust AI to have (e.g. driver assignment)
It's enough for me to have an overview of tasks that were created. I don't need to approve every action
I want to have control over driver assignments because of context
I want return and handover documents to be digital and automated
I want to know about behaviors where drivers don't comply with our guidelines
The biggest gap between operational work and AI capabilities helping is in Reporting
Detailed setup or potential activation of automatic mileage reminders for drivers (in system settings) was mentioned but not decided/configured
I want to reliably know how far a car drove between fuelling up
In order to add a UVV task to all vehicles, I need to click on all of them manually.
I want to know if drivers are doctoring the fuel numbers
I want to know the mileage of our leasing cars in order to evaluate whether they're within the contract boundaries and I need to change something
I spend so much time cleaning data in Avrios because I want the reports and statuses to be accurate
I want to be alerted about data anomalies in order to review and resolve them
Only if something requires my attention do I want to manually be involved. Otherwise I trust the AI

I want to know how much to sell our cars for

I want benchmarks when it comes to total cost of ownership in order to make data driven decisions

Users want one comprehensive handover/return report generated from the vehicle check
Description: Fleet managers want a single complete handover/return protocol produced from the vehicle check.

Insight: The handover/return protocol has workflow blockers in the vehicle-checklist flow
Description: Unresolved workflow blockers exist in the handover/return protocol within vehicle checklists.

Insight: Fleet managers want a shared replacement-car pool available across all sub-organizations
Description: A fleet with sub-organizations wants a replacement-car pool usable across all of them.

Insight: Fleet managers want the fine report linked to driver-license-check status
Description: They want regular links between the fine report and driver-license-check status to spot correlations.

Insight: Fleet managers want fine scan date and location fields as columns in the fine overview
Description: They want fine attributes (upload date, city, date forwarded, notification date, fine type) as overview columns for monthly reporting.

Insight: Fleet managers want the undivided annual fringe-benefit value and KM cost downloadable as report columns
Description: They want the yearly fringe-benefit value (not the /12 amount) and KM cost downloadable to run their own payroll calculations.

Insight: Fleet managers want the UVV certificate to show the driver's specific subsidiary, not the main account name
Description: In multi-entity companies the UVV certificate should display the driver's assigned subsidiary for legally accurate records.

Insight: Fleet managers want an audit log of driver-license-check rejections and reasons per driver
Description: They want a history of DLC rejections and reasons to address recurring issues and meet owner-liability compliance.

Insight: Fleet managers want to mark checklist items as non-critical so a negative answer skips the review queue
Description: They want to designate certain checklist items as non-blocking to avoid manually clearing routine negative responses.

Insight: Fleet managers want to configure which boolean answer triggers a checklist alert
Description: They want to set which answer value triggers a warning, to avoid confusing double-negative questions and false alerts.

Insight: Fleet managers want the first compliance-check reminder to fire immediately when a vehicle is added
Description: They want the initial recurring check to trigger at once on vehicle creation rather than after the first interval.

Insight: Fleet managers want to forward an entire procurement conversation thread, not just one message
Description: They need to forward whole procurement conversations, e.g. to a leasing contact's stand-in or as evidence.

Insight: Fleet managers want to record a purchase agreement with depreciation and a financing contract in parallel
Description: The system blocks parallel purchase-with-depreciation and financing contracts, forcing external workarounds for credit-financed purchases.

Insight: Fleet managers want a next-nearest-vehicle button when locating an available vehicle
Description: Only the single nearest vehicle is shown; they want to step through 2nd, 3rd nearest to dispatch efficiently.

Insight: Fleet managers want organization-level user rights so vehicles move between domains without support
Description: Moving vehicles between domains creates support load and data waste; they want org-level rights within one domain.

Insight: Fleet managers want a 'Not Ordered' procurement status
Description: A 'Not Ordered' status would keep canceled or paused procurements traceable without title-field workarounds that break replacement links.

Insight: Fleet managers want automated reminder emails redesigned so the company name is not cut off
Description: Cut-off company names make automated reminders look like spam and get ignored.

Insight: Fleet managers want a monthly breakdown option in consumption-report exports
Description: Consumption exports give cumulative totals; they want month-by-month grouping to spot spikes without manual Excel work.

Insight: Fleet managers want a dashboard showing the active fleet split by cost centre
Description: They want a quick dashboard view of the fleet split by cost centre, as already exists by vehicle type.

Insight: Fleet managers want a custom, non-straight-line depreciation schedule
Description: The system only allows equal-installment depreciation; they want per-year custom percentages or amounts.

Insight: Fleet managers want to reply or forward inbox messages without linking them to an order
Description: The procurement inbox is often used for non-procurement mail; they want to reply/forward without attaching to an order.

Insight: Fleet managers want newly linked inbox messages to stay marked unread
Description: When a message is linked to an order it should remain an unread notification so it is easy to find among many open procurements.

Insight: Fleet managers want to be notified when an email sent from a case bounces
Description: Beyond the send history, they want a bounce-back notification.

Insight: Fleet managers want a read-only fines role with task rights but no master-data access
Description: A role that views fines read-only and can modify tasks but cannot access master data.

Insight: Fleet managers want to customise the sender address and content for mileage reminders
Description: Mileage reminders are ignored or flagged as spam due to a generic sender; customisable sender and content are wanted.

Insight: Fleet managers want automated service tasks to include a country-specific instruction attachment
Description: Auto-generated service tasks should carry an attachment that differs by country policy.

Insight: Fleet managers want more granular damage-case statuses
Description: In damages they want to choose the case status (open, in progress, closed) with sub-states like awaiting-invoice or reported-to-leasing.

Insight: Fleet managers want task templates that can be due on a mileage interval, not only a date
Description: They want templates for mileage-interval tasks as well as date-interval ones.

Insight: Fleet managers want real-time alerts and a delivery-status report when fine emails fail
Description: They need instant bounce/SMTP-failure alerts plus a delivery-status report (recipient, timestamp, status, error, fine reference) for legal certainty.

Insight: Fleet managers want an Amount placeholder added to fine templates
Description: They want the auto-populated Amount field available as a fine-template placeholder.

Insight: Fleet managers want user rights scoped by vehicle type, not only by organization
Description: In large mixed fleets, users own specific vehicle types (vans, forklifts, cars); type-level rights would unblock large rollouts.

Insight: Bug: changing an overdue driver-license-check interval displays the interval as 0
Description: Changing the DLC interval for an overdue driver shows 0 instead of resetting the overdue status, causing confusion.

Insight: Fleet managers want a level-up navigation back to the vehicle task overview
Description: There is no direct navigation from a task back to the vehicle-specific task list; users rely on the browser back button.

Insight: Fleet managers want a short grace period instead of an immediate deadline for initial licence setup
Description: The initial driver-licence setup deadline is immediate; a few days' processing window would help. Nice-to-have.

Insight: Fleet managers want custom fields auto-filled based on the value of another custom field
Description: They want dependent custom fields populated automatically from a driving field's value.

Insight: Fleet managers want to manage the driver-declaration-to-authorities document in the platform
Description: They want to handle the point-penalty driver-declaration document within the system.

Insight: Fleet managers want templates for payment tasks within fines
Description: Option to create reusable templates for fine payment tasks.

Insight: Fleet managers want fringe-benefit value pro-rated to the days a driver was assigned in a month
Description: Mid-month assignment changes cannot be pro-rated, so some users compute fringe benefit offline.

Insight: Fleet managers want an alert when a refuel quantity exceeds the tank capacity
Description: They want an email alert when an uploaded fuel transaction shows a refill larger than the tank capacity.

Insight: Fleet managers want fines linked to and shown in the driver's master data
Description: Fines should appear as a tab or history in driver master data to avoid switching modules.

Insight: Fleet managers want a user role limited to driver-vehicle assignments only
Description: Colleagues who only change driver-vehicle assignments should not get full data access.

Insight: Fleet managers want driver-behaviour reporting for idling, harsh braking and speeding
Description: A competitor offers driver-behaviour telematics reporting to cut costs; this is missing here.

Insight: Accuracy issue: the consumption report shows different values in the Excel export vs in-app
Description: Different calculation methods produce mismatched consumption values between the app and its export, raising accuracy concerns; churn risk in the large-enterprise segment.

Insight: Fleet managers want custom procurement statuses for transparency
Description: Procurement and purchasing teams want custom statuses to track and overview cases.

Insight: Fleet managers want procurement directories grouped by financing type
Description: Users overseeing many procurements want directories per finance type such as leasing or purchase.

Insight: Fleet managers want to filter damages by purpose of trip in reporting
Description: A purpose-of-trip filter on the damage dashboard would enable more granular executive reporting.

Insight: Fleet managers want to choose which driver and vehicle fields appear in the driver app
Description: They want configurable driver-app fields such as fuel-card PIN, cost centre, contract end date and an intranet link. Nice-to-have.

Insight: Fleet managers want maintenance-contract costs displayable in the vehicle overview
Description: Maintenance-contract costs should be addable as a quick-filter column in the vehicle overview like leasing and insurance costs.

Insight: Fleet managers want UVV questions to vary by vehicle class
Description: All drivers currently take the full UVV test regardless of vehicle class; larger fleets want class-specific questions.

Insight: Fleet managers want blocking fees included in the premium-cost logic
Description: Blocking fees should be automatically charged to drivers via premium-cost logic; high request volume.

Insight: Fleet managers want fine emails sent from the user's personal address
Description: Drivers ignore or spam-filter the generic notification address; sending from a personal address would help.

Insight: Fleet managers want to create more than one payment task per fine
Description: They need multiple tasks per fine, e.g. a payment reminder plus a licence-details deadline.

Insight: Fleet managers want a sell-or-keep action for vehicles once depreciation ends
Description: After depreciation, cars appear under 'no financing costs'; users want a sell-or-keep option, e.g. a symbolic residual value.

Insight: Fleet managers want a reserved-licence-plate field in procurements, visible in the overview
Description: A field for the reserved licence plate in procurements, shown in the procurement overview.

Insight: Fleet managers want a 'fuel card ordered' checkbox in procurements, visible in the overview
Description: A check-field for whether fuel cards are ordered, shown in the procurement overview.

Insight: Fleet managers want the internal-comment field as a column in the procurement overview
Description: Users note info in internal comments and want it visible as an overview column so others need not open each procurement.

Insight: Bug: some euro values show three decimals in the vehicle overview
Description: The financing monthly-fee column sometimes shows three decimals; it should be two, as elsewhere.

Insight: Fleet managers want itemized fuel-consumption reporting (LNG vs diesel) for hybrids
Description: Hybrid fuel evaluations bundle all fuel types; users need separate LNG and diesel consumption for cost accounting.

Insight: Fleet managers want a field for lease special or down payments in the contract annex
Description: A dedicated field for optional lease down-payments so this core cost is tracked within the contract.

Insight: Fleet managers want separate fines email addresses per sub-organization
Description: Fines are mis-assigned to the main org; per-sub-org fines addresses would route them correctly.

Insight: Fleet managers want insurance details shown in the driver app
Description: They want insurance policy number, provider and emergency contact linked to driver contracts and surfaced in the driver app.

Insight: Fleet managers want task templates for damages, as exist for procurements and vehicles
Description: Tasks can be created in damages but not saved as templates.

Insight: Fleet managers want a native driver app instead of the browser-based one
Description: The browser app causes password and login issues, especially for less-digital drivers; a native app is requested.

Insight: Fleet managers want the pool-booking overview exportable to Excel
Description: The pool-booking overview should export to Excel.

Insight: Fleet managers want to adjust the close date when bulk-resolving recurring tasks
Description: For fixed-date recurring tasks such as annual vehicle tax, bulk-resolving forces the next due date off the original date.

Insight: Fleet managers want automated recurring report sending on a schedule
Description: Customers want reports (TCO/damage quarterly, flex biannually, overdue tasks weekly) sent automatically on schedule.

Insight: Fleet managers want the mileage driver's info added to the booking overview
Description: Request to show the mileage driver's info in the booking overview; no further detail provided.

Insight: Fleet managers want inspection checklists auto-sent to drivers at pool pickup and return
Description: Automatically send a digital inspection checklist when a pool vehicle is picked up or returned.

Insight: Fleet managers want manual approval for fuel invoices too, not just PDF invoices
Description: Fuel invoices auto-release; users want to review every invoice before release.

Insight: Fleet managers want per-organization invoice email addresses to include the org name
Description: When each org has its own invoice email, including the org name in the address makes the right one easy to find.

Insight: Fleet managers want a CC option when forwarding procurement messages to multiple people
Description: Users often need to forward a procurement message to several recipients.

Insight: Fleet managers want to bulk-update insurance contracts, e.g. via Excel import
Description: Yearly insurance-fee changes are too laborious to update, so some users stop maintaining insurance contracts.

Insight: Fleet managers want to bulk-update annual vehicle-tax values, e.g. via Excel import
Description: Yearly vehicle-tax changes are too laborious to update manually.

Insight: Fleet managers want to add variations to insurance contracts, as with leasing
Description: Insurance contracts should support variations like leasing contracts do.

Insight: Fleet managers want a shared workshop-appointment calendar with key dates
Description: They want a workshop and maintenance calendar (currently in Outlook) plus a shared calendar of tasks, contract ends and maintenance.

Insight: Fleet managers want a mobile-friendly admin app
Description: The admin experience is poor on mobile; the pool calendar and filtered vehicle lists are hard to use on a phone.

Insight: Fleet managers want AI to detect fuel and consumption anomalies with automatic alerts
Description: Multiple customers want AI anomaly detection: consumption-vs-mileage discrepancies, duplicate/night/weekend refills, non-fuel purchases, AdBlue misuse and lease-vs-invoice mismatches.

Insight: Fleet managers want to add notes to procurements, as in damages, especially on quotes
Description: They want a note function on procurements and quotes to record why quote prices differ, since details are forgotten over months.

Insight: Fleet managers want vehicle age shown as years, months and days rather than decimals
Description: Age shown as a decimal like 1.08 years is unhelpful; they want years, months and days.

Insight: Fleet managers want damage invoices to also appear under the vehicle's invoices tab
Description: Damage-related invoices do not show under invoices; users expect them in the vehicle's invoice overview.

Insight: Fleet managers want to filter and prioritise system-generated tasks on the home dashboard
Description: Procurement-template tasks flood the home overview and bury real due-today tasks; users want filtering and dating of system tasks.

Insight: Fleet managers want workshop-order usability fixes
Description: Several workshop-order issues: clicking opens the quote not the overview, can't close without an end date, can be closed without an appointment, and type/assignment are not editable.

Insight: Fleet managers want fine reply emails to auto-route to a shared team address
Description: When a driver replies to a fine notification the reply should go to a shared mailbox, not the individual sender who may be out of office.

Insight: Fleet managers want automatic driver reminders when a licence is about to expire
Description: Auto-send licence-expiry reminders directly to drivers to ensure timely renewal without manual follow-up.

Insight: Fleet managers want a default attachment auto-added to fine payment tasks
Description: The driver-declaration form is always the same and should attach automatically to payment tasks instead of being added manually each time.

Insight: Fleet managers want a returns-planning overview of soon-returning company cars with location and features
Description: Large-fleet managers want to know in advance when and where a vehicle frees up and its features, to reassign efficiently and cut downtime.

Insight: Fleet managers want an upload field within the multi-step contract approval process
Description: Approvers should be able to add and sign contract PDFs within the approval flow so the manager ends with one fully signed contract.

Insight: Drivers want the DLC notification to state which specific document is requested
Description: The DLC email or SMS does not say which document (licence vs driver card) is needed, causing wrong uploads and rework.

Insight: Fleet managers want to buy Austrian road toll within the platform
Description: Let drivers and admins purchase road toll in-app and include it in TCO and other reports.

Insight: Fleet managers want a saved address book of authority emails for fines
Description: Authority and parking-enforcement emails are often missing and manually searched each time; a saved contact memory would cut repetitive lookups and misrouting risk.

Insight: Fleet managers want continuous sync of a replaced vehicle's cost centre into open procurements
Description: A replacement procurement pulls the cost centre once; later changes are not re-synced and must be fixed manually.

Insight: Fleet managers want to open a replacement procurement directly from the vehicle
Description: Users must go back to procurements or decommissioning; they want to start a replacement from within the vehicle file.

Insight: Fleet managers want to select multiple options within one overview filter
Description: Filters allow one value; users want to select several, e.g. all hybrid fuel-type variants at once.

Insight: Fleet managers want to reuse the same contact email across multiple vendors
Description: An email can belong to only one vendor; users want a warn-and-confirm on reuse instead of fake-email workarounds.

Insight: Fleet admins want to edit and correct submitted driver checklists
Description: Drivers sometimes enter wrong values such as freight temperatures; admins want to correct submitted checklists for accurate compliance records.

Insight: Fleet managers want to create leasing contracts without a contractual mileage
Description: Residual-value and flat-rate leases have no mileage; users are forced to enter placeholder values that confuse mileage reporting.

Insight: Fleet managers want to delete or archive obsolete checklists without support
Description: Removing test or unused checklists requires a support ticket and long waits; self-service deletion is wanted.

Insight: Fleet managers want to move multiple documents between folders in bulk
Description: Users move sets of inspection documents one by one; a bulk move is wanted.

Insight: Fleet managers want non-admin users to trigger odometer requests, and to do so in bulk from the vehicle list
Description: A large customer wants non-admin read/write users to send odometer requests and to trigger them via multi-select bulk action.

Insight: Fleet managers want multiple item-specific comment fields in vehicle-check templates
Description: A single general comment box forces drivers to bundle notes; item-specific comment fields would structure feedback.

Insight: Fleet managers want an internal, manager-only comment field on vehicle checks
Description: Any note in the system is driver-visible; managers want internal notes hidden from drivers for follow-ups.

Insight: Fleet managers want tire dimensions available in reports and exports
Description: Tire dimensions exist in master data but cannot be included in reports; needed for seasonal tire-service lists.

Insight: Fleet managers want depreciation plans for operating-hours assets such as forklifts
Description: Purchase contracts with depreciation cannot be assigned to operating-hours vehicles; mixed fleets need this.

Insight: Fleet managers want a task odometer field separate from the vehicle odometer, allowing historical values
Description: An odometer entered on a retroactive task is validated against the current higher reading and rejected; a non-validating historical field is needed.

Insight: Fleet managers want drivers to update a changed licence number during a repeat DLC
Description: If a licence number changes between checks the driver is locked out and the manager must archive and re-initiate the DLC manually.

Insight: Fleet managers want PDF exports filtered by driver, not just by vehicle
Description: They want a driver-based PDF export of all completed and categorised trips for one driver, like the vehicle-based one.

Insight: Fleet managers want odometer values shown as numbers, not text, in Excel exports
Description: Odometer records export as text; users want them as numbers. Nice-to-have.

Insight: Fleet managers want the mobile phone number on the damage-report PDF when the landline is empty
Description: The damage PDF shows only the landline; it should fall back to the mobile number.

Insight: Fleet managers want a scheduled-date column and dynamic master-data display in the task overview
Description: They want a toggleable execution-date column and automatic display of relevant custom fields such as tire storage or preferred workshop in the task view.

Insight: Fleet managers want to save ad-hoc tasks as templates during creation
Description: A checkbox to save a task as a template while creating it, instead of building templates separately.

Insight: Fleet managers want to auto-generate driver assignment letters on company letterhead
Description: On new assignments, generate an assignment letter with vehicle, dates, driver and fringe benefit on the company letterhead from data already in the system.

Insight: Fleet managers want sub-org users to access mailroom documents via dedicated sub-org addresses
Description: Mailroom documents go to the main org so sub-org users cannot see them; per-sub-org mailroom addresses are needed.

Insight: Fleet managers want the expected budget shown next to a procurement offer
Description: They want the policy- and level-based expected budget beside the received offer to see quickly if it fits or must be charged to the driver.

Insight: Fleet managers want a pop-up shortcut to open the case a mailroom document was added to
Description: Like the claims inbox pop-up, a shortcut to jump straight to the updated case such as a claim or fine.

Insight: Fleet managers want to build custom reports from task data
Description: Task data cannot be used in custom reports; users want all task data points available.

Insight: Fleet managers want driver-app login by username instead of email
Description: Many drivers have no company email; a username-and-password login (like the old PIN users) is wanted, especially for migrated customers.

Insight: Fleet managers want auto-forwarding of specific mailroom documents, e.g. to insurers
Description: Documents often need forwarding, e.g. to insurance; automating this would raise mailroom value (vertical potential).

Insight: Fleet managers want per-sub-org mailroom integration addresses
Description: Mailroom-address documents land in the main org; per-sub-org addresses, like invoice integration, are needed.

Insight: Fleet managers want a tasks-only user role with read-only master data
Description: A restricted role limited to task handling (attachments, create/resolve) with read-only master data.

Insight: Fleet managers want a fringe-benefit-only user role
Description: A role that can only access the fringe-benefit tab in read and write mode.

Insight: Bug: deleted pool groups still appear in the pool-calendar sort menu
Description: Only existing pool groups should show in sort-pools; deleted ones should not.

Insight: Fleet managers want to attach invoices to a procurement before the vehicle is active
Description: Down-payment invoices arrive before the vehicle is active; users want to attach them to the procurement and reallocate cost when the vehicle activates.

Insight: Fleet managers want to assign vehicle checks during vehicle creation
Description: Checks must be added on a separate screen after creation and are often forgotten; assigning them in the creation flow prevents compliance gaps.

Insight: Fleet managers want decision-ready pool-vehicle utilization logic, not just raw data
Description: A large customer can extract data but cannot judge which pool vehicles are under-utilised or should be relocated; they want a multi-factor utilization score (frequency, days-in-use, trip patterns) for keep/move decisions.

Insight: Fleet managers want instant tasks that notify the driver immediately
Description: Task emails have a minimum one-day delay; urgent tasks need immediate notification.

Insight: Fleet managers want a feedback comment when a task is closed
Description: A closing comment, e.g. noting a problem found during the task, would aid task-management adoption.

Insight: Fleet managers want the recognised contract number included in auto-generated file names
Description: For the mailroom auto-naming feature, include the contract number found in the document.

Insight: Fleet managers want recognised contract documents stored in the contracts section
Description: A contract document recognised in the mailroom should be stored in, or linked to, the contracts section.

Insight: Fleet managers want to customise which premium fuels a driver may buy
Description: Customers want to define allowed premium fuels, since premium can sometimes be cheaper than standard.

Insight: Fleet managers want batched, auto-dismissing, user-targeted fine-import notifications
Description: Processing a batch of fines spawns many stacked pop-ups shown to all users; they want a single summary, auto-dismiss, targeting only the initiator, and an opt-out.

Insight: Fleet managers want the starting/handover mileage shown prominently on mileage monitoring
Description: The handover odometer is not displayed; users dig through history to find it for calculations.

Insight: Fleet managers want reporting to reflect actual lease payments, not just contract dates
Description: Some lessors charge the first month fully and skip the last, so contract-date-based reports do not match the ledger.

Insight: Fleet managers want the procurement title, not just the number, as a column in the task overview
Description: Tasks tied to a procurement show only the number; the title would identify the future vehicle.

Insight: Fleet managers want custom fields in damage management
Description: Custom fields are considered essential in the damage module.

Insight: Fleet managers want the case number auto-filled into the damage-number field
Description: Users manually copy the case number into the damage-number field; auto-fill is wanted. Nice-to-have.

Insight: Fleet managers want to create folders and subfolders directly from the mailroom
Description: When uploading, users find a folder missing and want to create it in the mailroom, as with creating a damage.

Insight: Fleet managers want to link a mailroom document to a procurement
Description: In bulk upload, users want to attach a document to an existing or new procurement.

Insight: Fleet managers want the mailroom to hide smime.p7s signature files
Description: Digitally signed emails show an irrelevant smime.p7s file that should not be displayed.

Insight: Fleet managers want batch scanning with automatic separation for fines
Description: Fines must be scanned individually; batch scan with automatic separation would save time. Nice-to-have.

Insight: Fleet managers want latest messages shown at the top of each conversation
Description: Users want newest messages on top instead of scrolling to the end each time.

Insight: Fleet managers want to download or forward mis-routed invoices from the mailroom
Description: Non-fleet documents sometimes land in the mailroom; users want to download or forward them (with CC and a template) to the right team.

Insight: Fleet managers want truck licence classes and their medical and qualification expiries tracked
Description: For heavy-vehicle classes, users need class-specific expiries, medical certificates and professional-driver qualifications tracked in-platform; today it is manual spreadsheets.

Insight: Fleet managers want a mailroom notification badge for new uploads
Description: A notification next to the mailroom menu when new documents are uploaded and processed, like fines and procurement.

Insight: Inconsistency: fines behave differently via the mailroom vs the fines email address
Description: Sending a fine to the mailroom address splits it into several documents (some unsupported) and mislabels them, unlike the fines address which processes it as one case.

Insight: Fleet managers want drivers set up as PIN users for the driver app
Description: Not all drivers have a company email, so PIN-user setup is wanted.

Insight: Drivers want to end a booking early
Description: Only full cancellation is possible; drivers want to end a booking before its scheduled end.

Insight: Fleet managers want to reorder steps and items within vehicle checks
Description: A fixed order forces drivers to enter interior data before exterior photos; a logical exterior-first reorder would ease pre-trip checks.

Insight: Fleet managers want to detect and restrict address changes used to hide private vehicle use
Description: A large fleet found users editing trip destinations to the nearest station to disguise private use; they want geofencing, clearer export of changes and in-app monitoring.

Insight: Fleet managers want the auto-approval process applied at the mailroom level
Description: Auto-approval does not work on mailroom documents, so users approve each manually; bulk-select approval is wanted.

Insight: Fleet managers want drag-and-drop column reordering for master data
Description: Users want to reorder master-data columns via drag and drop.

Insight: Fleet managers want to bulk-set invoice line items to standard when an invoice is read as a contract
Description: When an invoice is recognised as a contract, users must change each position to standard; a one-step change is wanted.

Insight: Fleet managers want to duplicate or clone invoice line items
Description: Imported invoices often need splitting across vehicles; cloning line items would avoid manual re-entry.

Insight: Fleet managers want a mailroom notification with a new-document count
Description: A badge showing the number of new mailroom documents, like the fines symbol.

Insight: Fleet managers want recurring-task due dates to stay fixed, not shift with completion date
Description: For fixed-date obligations such as annual inspections and tire changes, the due date must stay fixed regardless of early completion; flagged as a blocker.

Insight: Fleet managers want a return checklist auto-sent when a pool booking ends
Description: Automatically send a return checklist when a pool booking terminates, to capture condition, mileage and damages.

Insight: Fleet managers want to order multiple vehicles of the same type in a single procurement
Description: Large fleets order in batches and want a quota procurement from which individual vehicles are activated on delivery.

Insight: Fleet managers want a link to booking details in the bookings list
Description: Partially filled request to add a link to booking details in the bookings list; little detail provided.

Insight: UX: procurement-template tasks all fall due today and bury genuinely due tasks
Description: Template-generated procurement tasks all show as due today on the main page, hiding tasks that are really due.

Insight: Fleet managers want bookings auto-deleted when a driver is set inactive
Description: When a driver is marked inactive their future bookings should be deleted, ideally with a confirm pop-up, so the vehicle is not blocked.

Insight: Fleet managers want a notification when a DLC needs their review
Description: Managers want an email or in-app alert, individual or weekly, when a driver has completed a check needing verification.

Insight: Fleet managers want fines on shared vehicles assigned to the driver from the booking calendar
Description: For shared vehicles, fines should be attributed to whoever was driving per the shared-vehicle calendar.

Insight: Fleet managers want more granular user permissions
Description: For example, users with only pool-reservation access should not reach master data, vehicles, documents or contracts.

Insight: Fleet managers want an ending-mileage field and in-booking damage reporting for pool vehicles
Description: On return there is no mileage entry and no way to log damage against the booked vehicle; users want an ending-mileage field, a distance calc, and a damage report with photos and a roadworthiness flag.

Insight: Fleet managers want a mandatory policy-acknowledgement checkbox for pool bookings
Description: Store internal fleet policies and require drivers to confirm they have read them before finalising a pool booking.

Insight: Fleet managers want an assigned-organizations filter in the driver list, as in vehicles
Description: Organizations are not shown in the driver-list filter as they are for vehicles.

Insight: Fleet managers want to connect multiple emails to the same fine
Description: Users want to forward a driver's confirmation email and attach it to an existing fine instead of screenshotting it.

Insight: Fleet managers want a collective lease invoice filed to each vehicle's contract folder without being processed as an invoice
Description: A monthly collective lease invoice covering several vehicles should be stored in each vehicle's contract folder for reference, not read as an invoice, since costs are already recorded.

Insight: Fleet managers want on-site manual DLC via manager PIN with optional photo, respecting works-council and privacy rules
Description: For non-smartphone drivers and strict privacy or works-council settings, managers want to clear checks on-site via PIN without a mandatory photo, preserving the automated schedule; flagged as a churn risk.

Insight: Bug: fuel-card assignment start date is not marked as a required field
Description: When a vehicle is chosen for a fuel card, the start-assignment-date field should be marked required, and vice versa.

Insight: Fleet managers want rich-text formatting in fine-management email templates
Description: The template editor is plain-text; users want bold, underline and colour, plus brand-compliant signatures.

Insight: Fleet managers want a separate internal template name vs the outbound email subject
Description: Template names auto-derive from the subject and truncate; users want a short internal label plus a descriptive subject, and resizable columns.

Insight: Fleet managers want a central admin area to manage fine email templates
Description: Users must open a specific fine case to edit templates; a standalone template settings area is wanted, like task templates.

Insight: Fleet managers want an uploaded PDF on the vehicle file to auto-fetch the licence plate
Description: Invoices uploaded at vehicle level are not linked to the vehicle; auto-detecting the plate would remove manual adjustment.

Insight: Fleet managers want to upload PDF fuel invoices directly
Description: Many fuel invoices arrive as PDF; users currently convert to CSV/XLS or build Excel manually, which is painful, especially for EV providers.

Insight: Fleet managers want clear classification of involved parties in the damage-export PDF
Description: The damage PDF does not clearly mark who is injured party, witness or owner; users edit the PDF or dump names in free text before sending to insurers.

Insight: Performance: importing fines via the mailroom is much slower than the fines portal
Description: Fine import through the mailroom takes far longer than uploading via the fines portal.

Insight: Fleet managers want single-choice (radio or dropdown) answers in vehicle checklists
Description: Checklists only support binary pass/fail; multi-option questions cause false errors, so single-choice options are wanted.

Insight: Fleet managers want configurable BEV charging-cost and standing/blocking-fee alerts
Description: An e-mobility fleet wants adjustable alerts for expensive charging and for overnight standing or blocking fees, to cut costs and enforce driver discipline.

Insight: Fleet managers want overdue DLC checks escalated to a supervisor automatically
Description: When a driver misses a DLC deadline, auto-escalate to a defined manager instead of manual follow-up.

Insight: Fleet managers want tasks grouped by vehicle on the dashboard
Description: On hovering or selecting a task, show other open tasks for the same vehicle, with a do-these-too prompt.

Insight: Fleet managers want mileage-based, or combined, frequency in task templates
Description: Task templates only support time-based frequency; mileage or combined intervals are wanted.

Insight: Bug: tax recalculation only triggers when the fuel type is toggled
Description: After correcting a wrong tax factor, recalculation only happens if the fuel type is switched and back; it should trigger on any factor change.

Insight: Bug: a tax value of 0 is treated as missing data
Description: For EVs a tax amount of 0 is handled as empty; users want to mark 'no taxes' without it showing as missing info.

Insight: Fleet managers want automatic readout of vehicle registration papers on upload
Description: Auto-read registration papers during vehicle creation and only fill missing fields from the external database, which is often wrong.

Insight: Fleet managers want tire-purchase invoice data added to the vehicle's tire reference data
Description: When a tire purchase is detected on an invoice, prompt to add it to the tire section and specify which axles, like fuel-card notices.

Insight: Fleet managers want the DLC to match licence class against the assigned vehicle
Description: The DLC only checks that a licence exists, not whether its class matches the vehicle; users want an automatic class-vs-vehicle match to ensure authorisation.

Insight: Regression: PDF invoice cost-allocation and line-item itemization no longer work after the AI-readout change
Description: Customers report the new AI reader no longer auto-allocates costs via a device identifier nor splits line items, forcing manual allocation and losing per-transaction detail; perceived as a service downgrade.

Insight: Fleet managers want a tracking overview for mileage and odometer requests
Description: No view shows to whom a mileage request was sent and whether it was answered; a dashboard is wanted.

Insight: Fleet managers want mileage monitoring based on contract year with a percentage display
Description: Monitoring uses total contract mileage; users want per-contract-year tracking, a percentage of contracted mileage, and correct over-mileage colour flags.

Insight: Fleet managers want suspicious refuelling flagged against tank size
Description: Refuelling that exceeds the tank size should be recognised as suspicious.

Insight: Drivers want more info in the driver app such as lease location, tire location and insurance contacts
Description: Users want the driver app to show where the vehicle is leased, where tires are stored, and insurance, leasing and tire contacts.

Insight: Fleet managers want the comment field visible in the procurement overview
Description: Users track procurement status in the comment field and want it visible on the overview tab.

Insight: UX: the mailroom cannot clearly identify documents and cannot re-upload after an error
Description: Documents are not clearly identified, and after an error users must find the original files again to re-upload.

Insight: Fleet managers want a location-history field so cost reports can be run by vehicle location
Description: Vehicle location changes over time independent of company or cost centre; users need location history for cost reporting.

Insight: Fleet managers want WhatsApp messaging to drivers from within the platform
Description: Drivers ignore email; managers want in-app WhatsApp for checks and handovers with a GDPR-compliant, documented audit trail; possible premium upsell.

Insight: Fleet managers want to report the leasing return date entered during decommissioning
Description: Users want the decommissioning leasing-return date available in reporting.

Insight: Fleet managers want variable recurring task intervals, e.g. first at 4 years then every 2
Description: French technical-inspection rules need a 4-year first interval then 2-year cycles; fixed intervals cannot model this.

Insight: Fleet managers want multi-level pool-booking approvals
Description: Bookings should route through tiered approvals: line manager, director if over three days, then fleet manager.

Insight: Fleet managers want a full, legally binding handover/return report in the Vehicle Check
Description: Managers want a handover/return protocol with an accessories checklist (cards, tire storage, key counts), mandatory attachments, comments and dual e-signatures, replacing paper forms.

Insight: Fleet managers want the driver number (licence field 4d) extracted during verification
Description: In regions where insurers require field 4d, extracting and storing it avoids storing full licence images and speeds claims.

Insight: Fleet managers want lease under-mileage thresholds modelled in contracts
Description: Some leases only reimburse under-mileage beyond a set threshold up to a cap; today only the maximum is mappable, not the starting threshold.

Insight: Fleet managers want AdBlue excluded from premium-fuel warnings
Description: Diesel EURO 6C+ (and future gasoline EURO7+) vehicles require AdBlue, so it should not trigger premium-fuel warnings.

Insight: Fleet managers want recurring notifications listing invoices with missing info or rejected
Description: A scheduled report of missing-info or rejected invoices would let a central supervisor act without logging in; useful across multi-country deployments.

Insight: Fleet managers want to attach a map location link to damages
Description: Users want to enter a Google-Maps location link for the damage.

Insight: Fleet managers want custom procurement statuses and status tags on the procurement grid
Description: Rigid Quote/Delivery/Approval stages force title-field workarounds that break replacement links; multiple enterprise accounts want custom statuses plus grid tags.

Insight: Fleet managers want flexible columns and custom-metadata visibility in procurement and vehicle overviews
Description: Overviews cannot show custom metadata such as status comments, fuel-card confirmations, reserved plates or tracking IDs; several enterprise accounts want configurable columns to avoid opening each record.

Insight: Fleet managers want procurement-inbox email controls: CC, thread forwarding, unread persistence and sorting
Description: The procurement inbox lacks CC forwarding, whole-thread forwarding, unread persistence, unlinked replies and newest-first sorting; high-volume comms teams need these for coverage and compliance.

Insight: Fleet managers want insurance costs split per contract in the fleet cost overview
Description: A customer with two active insurance contracts sees only the combined cost, not per-contract.

Insight: Fleet managers want folder-level user rights so not all users can open procurement-folder documents
Description: Not all users should see documents in the procurement folder; folder-level access rights are wanted.

Insight: I go straight to pricing before looking at product or feature content.
Description: Several prospects treated Tarife as their first or primary CTA, often before reading any value content.

Insight: I don't trust a package recommendation the site makes before it knows my requirements.
Description: Prospects wanted a short qualifying questionnaire that then returns a recommended tier.

Insight: I couldn't find the differences between packages because I didn't scroll to the comparison table.
Description: Package titles aren't sticky and the full feature table sits well below the highlights; several didn't reach it.

Insight: I want pricing banded by fleet size, not only shown per vehicle.
Description: Per-vehicle price went unnoticed by at least one prospect; they expected tiers by vehicle-count band.

Insight: Percentage claims like "92% less admin" feel exaggerated when I don't yet know the effort involved.
Description: Stat teaser modules read as reißerisch; prospects preferred to judge the value themselves.

Insight: I want to play with a live sandbox of a handful of dummy vehicles before booking anything.
Description: Repeated request for a self-serve interactive trial over a gated sales demo.

Insight: I don't want to hand over company data just to see a demo.
Description: One prospect resisted lead capture and wanted an anonymised self-test.

Insight: I'm unsure whether "kostenlose Demo", "Demo buchen" and "kostenlos testen" mean a download, the live product, or a sales call.
Description: CTA labels are conflated; prospects expected different things behind each.

Insight: Being able to book a demo slot directly in a calendar felt great.
Description: Direct calendar booking was received far more positively than a contact form.

Insight: I want a short video showing how to add a vehicle and how invoicing works.
Description: A 3-4 minute walkthrough was requested to replace manual, text-heavy feature pages.

Insight: I didn't notice the site navigation.
Description: Nav read as low-visibility; a transparent CTA in the nav was acceptable but easily missed.

Insight: I scroll past the tab sections under the hero instead of clicking through them.
Description: Tab-based content organisation under the hero was frequently bypassed.

Insight: I prefer German labels; English feature names like "damage" confuse me.
Description: German-speaking prospects found English feature terms a barrier.

Insight: The package name "Enterprise" confused me; I expected something like "Premium".
Description: Tier naming misread (Star Trek association / language barrier).

Insight: I don't understand what "Fringe Benefits" means.
The euro symbol on add-ons is unclear and needs an explanation.
Compliance (fines and violations handling) is attractive because the company bears the cost.
Description: Seen as a differentiator; not integrated in the prospect's incumbent tool.

Insight: I don't believe damage management reduces the damage rate because the human factor dominates.
Description: Prospects read the bullets but couldn't see the mechanism; the claim met scepticism.

Insight: I ignore the testimonial slider and trust numbers, data and customer logos instead.
Description: Testimonials were consistently skipped; logos were read as proof the tool is established.

Insight: Seeing known customer logos above the fold makes the tool feel established and trustworthy.
Description: The live version with logos above the fold was preferred.

Insight: The design looks clean and trustworthy but a bit monochrome; I'd like more colour.
I don't understand why there are separate sub-brands or what "by Shiftmove" means for a feature.
Description: The "Vimcar by Shiftmove" / Motum sub-brand structure confused a prospect, who worried a feature could disappear if a sub-brand ended its contract.

Insight: Interfaces to fuel cards, leasing providers and accounting are a decision-critical worry for me.
Description: Recurring doubt that individual integration needs are covered by standard pricing; the human factor is the pain when a new interface is required.

Insight: The new vehicle-procurement page doesn't convince me as a USP and I want to see the workflow, not manual entry.
Description: Procurement-relevant prospects wanted automation and supplier-interface detail rather than a feature teaser.

Insight: I can't roll out the driver app because not all field staff have a company email address.
Description: Email-dependent onboarding blocks pool-vehicle reservation; QR / Microsoft Forms workarounds are used instead.

Insight: After scanning the hero I could describe the value as automating processes to save time, cut costs and ensure legal certainty.
Description: The hero value proposition was broadly understood in prospects' own words.

Insight: When I click "alle Vorteile entdecken" I expect a concise one-page bulleted overview of all benefits with short explanations.
The further down the page I scroll, the less relevant the information feels.
Description: Prospects perceived information relevance degrading below the fold.

Insight: I want to see actual product screens rather than handbook-style descriptions.
Description: The status quo felt static; prospects wanted to see the masks and KPIs and judge fit themselves.

Insight: I would start with the cheapest package and upgrade only if it isn't enough.
